sophie_cs: Heads-up: New customer GlideLabs is seeing a UX regression right after SDK install. Hundreds of short 429 bursts for a few minutes, then clears. Happened during internal beta ramp.

li_dev: do we have request samples? are the 429s coming from preflight or generation endpoints?

sophie_cs: user pasted logs: most 429s are preflight /auth/verify. Retry-After header is inconsistent (sometimes 0, sometimes 2). They say this appears when mobile web users open app and service-worker spawns 4 workers.

own_eng: sounds like a preflight stampede + immediate retries. Mobile service-workers + background tabs can spawn parallel preflight flows and race token refreshes.

li_dev: suggested client config to throttle and coalesce preflights: ```js
// per-app singleton leader for refresh + coalesce
const sdk = new RedwoodSDK({
  preflight: { maxConcurrent: 1, coalesceWindowMs: 400 },
  retry: { baseMs: 300, maxMs: 3000, jitter: true, respectRetryAfter: true }
});
```

sophie_cs: customer said they can't change service-worker logic quickly. Can we offer a temporary onboarding bump?

onboard-bot: Quota change requested by sophie_cs for tenant glide-009: +40% burst for 3 hours (audit q-2026-1768).

noah_sales: flagging potential renewal risk; poor initial experience for beta could affect decision. If >6h we'll offer deep-dive.

own_eng: also check their auth TTL: if TTL is short (30s) and many tabs refresh at TTL-1, auth service could transiently throttle. Recommend TTL extend to 2m during ramp.

li_dev: I'll open INF-3489 to add metric tags: tenant=glide-009 preflight.spam_count and auth.refresh_leaders. We should correlate with quota bumps.

sophie_cs: I'll send concise steps + the SDK snippet to GlideLabs and schedule a 30-min sync at 10am PT tomorrow. Will confirm whether they accepted the quota window.

noah_sales: thanks. keep me posted before the sync; I'll join if they look unhappy.

li_dev: ticket INF-3489 created.

own_eng: quick mitigation checklist: 1) temporarily increase burst, 2) extend ephemeral TTL during ramp, 3) add jittered/backoff client, 4) implement single-refresh leader in workers, 5) sync clocks on their fleet.

sophie_cs: great, closing this thread for follow-up after the 10am sync.
